title: Ledup header
description: A fixed, barless header: a plain italic wordmark at the left, a frosted light-grey pill of four links in the middle (the first with a chevron), and a taupe Contact pill with two taupe circle buttons (search, account) at the right. Links get a pale greige pill on hover (0.1s). On phones only the wordmark and a two-line burger show; the burger opens a full-screen link list.
notes: fixed to the top with no background of its own: it floats over the hero and the page (the nav pill is translucent and blurred)
needs JavaScript for the phone menu (hydrate: load)
